issue.title: Allow a per instance delay on UTooltip
issue.body:
### Description

It would be great if `UTooltip` accepted a `delay` per instance. Today the delay can only be set once on the provider, so a dense toolbar and a help icon on the same page have to share it.

### Proposed API

```vue
<UTooltip text="Save" :delay="0" />
```

### Why

Toolbars want instant tooltips, form hints want a slower one. Nothing is broken today, this is a new option.
